name: AWS - IAM
notes: boto3 ListUsers is the IAM query protocol. POST / matches Action=ListUsers from the form body or the query string and returns ListUsersResponse XML in the namespace https://iam.amazonaws.com/doc/2010-05-08/.
ListUsersResult/Users/member includes Path, UserName, UserId, Arn, and CreateDate. IsTruncated and Marker page with MaxItems. ResponseMetadata/RequestId is present.
Access keys and policies are omitted. The Marker is pp_ plus a base36 index. Version is not checked. SigV4 is not checked.
